h1: Custom Wood Rulers for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom wood rulers for your brand. Perfect for schools, offices, and promotions. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Wood rulers bring a natural, tactile feel that plastic or metal alternatives can't match. They're ideal for schools, woodworking shops, or any brand that values sustainability and craftsmanship. With options like the Beech Star Award or a classic yardstick, these rulers offer a warm, premium surface for screen printing or engraving your logo. Choose custom wood rulers to convey durability and eco-consciousness in every measurement.
heroAltText: Custom wood rulers in bulk with engraved logo, natural wood finish, measuring 12 inches
